name: OpenBounty Winner
description: Proof that this wallet won a prize tier in an OpenBounty bounty. The badge's on-chain name gives the bounty title and the prize number. The OpenBounty program on Solana (3xbu7yrMBpbhtzb5FqJgTydvEtPHBKWoQAQ5Vaw5nMCM) mints a badge only to the winner that the bounty's judges voted for.
